title: Chump CAPABILITIES_REGISTRY.json schema (INFRA-1729)
description: Machine-readable inventory of repository primitives (CLI commands, ambient event kinds, public crate APIs, MCP tools, skills, scripts). Produced by scripts/dev/build-capabilities-registry.sh against the current repo, or by scripts/ops/generate-capabilities-registry.sh <repo-path> against an arbitrary repo (the Column A `chump ingest` Quartermaster artifact). External agents (Cannon, Choreographer, Content Bots) declare this file as their tool-discovery input — replaces grep-and-pray primitive discovery.

_read_me_first.description: CREDIBLE-240. Plain-language banner at the head of the document, stating that this is a generated file and naming the date after which it must not be believed. It lives inside the artifact because almanac indexes this JSON and can hand an agent a chunk of it with a file:line receipt — that reader may never see any surrounding documentation.

stale_after.description: CREDIBLE-240. generated_at + staleness_policy.max_age_days, as an absolute timestamp. Stated absolutely so a reader that cannot execute code (an LLM quoting this file) can judge freshness by comparing today's date, with no arithmetic.

staleness_policy.description: CREDIBLE-240. How freshness is defined and who enforces it.

content_sha256.description: CREDIBLE-240. SHA-256 over the substantive sections only (schema_version, repo, cli_commands, event_kinds, crate_apis, mcp_tools, primitives, related_registries) — timestamps deliberately excluded. Lets the regeneration job tell 'the repo changed' apart from 'time passed', so it commits on real drift rather than once per run.

cli_source.description: CREDIBLE-240. Where cli_commands came from: 'src/main.rs:print_help' (deterministic source parse, preferred), 'chump --help (PATH binary — not reproducible)', or 'none'. Recorded because parsing a PATH binary makes the output depend on whichever build happens to be installed on the generating machine.

overlay_status.description: CREDIBLE-240. 'applied' | 'absent' | 'FAILED:<Error>'. A missing PyYAML used to drop every curated when_to_use string from docs/CAPABILITIES_OVERLAY.yaml without a word; this field makes that degradation visible in the artifact itself.

related_registries.description: CREDIBLE-240. Sibling catalogs and how to join to them. This registry holds TOOLS; privateer/charter.json holds PROVIDERS. Without an explicit pointer, 'which provider does this tool front' had no answer in either file.

join.description: How to correlate rows across the two files.

repo.description: Repository identifier (e.g. 'repairman29/chump' or basename of the target path when no GitHub remote is configured).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this registry was generated.

generator_version.description: Generator commit SHA or version tag — lets consumers detect stale registries after a generator-format bump.

cli_commands.description: Top-level CLI commands exposed by the repo's main binary (parsed from --help recursively).

event_kinds.description: Ambient event kinds registered in docs/observability/EVENT_REGISTRY.yaml.

crate_apis.description: Every crate in the workspace. Discovery reads [workspace].members from the root Cargo.toml, falling back to a recursive scan of crates/. CREDIBLE-240 widened this from the original one-level, library-only 'crates/*/src/lib.rs' scan, which silently omitted 14 of chump's 47 packages — including all 7 crates under crates/mcp-servers/, every binary-only crate, and the root package.

crate_kind.description: CREDIBLE-240. Which entry points the crate has. public_items is only populated for lib and lib+bin.

entry_file.description: CREDIBLE-240. Repo-relative path to src/lib.rs, src/main.rs, or Cargo.toml — whichever the crate actually has. Primitives cite this instead of assuming src/lib.rs, which produced dangling receipts for binary crates.

ecosystem.description: INFRA-3469. Which ecosystem adapter produced this entry. Defaults to 'rust' for entries written before this field existed. js_ts entries are discovered via package.json + main/module/types entry resolution; python entries via top-level __init__.py packages.

kind.description: fn / struct / enum / trait / mod / const / type

mcp_tools.description: MCP tools — sourced from chump-mcp.json server descriptors plus #[chump_tool] macro annotations in src/. CREDIBLE-240: servers marked enabled:false are LISTED with enabled:false rather than dropped. Omitting them made the catalog assert that a wired-but-switched-off server did not exist at all.

enabled.description: CREDIBLE-240. False for servers declared in chump-mcp.json but switched off.

file_path.description: CREDIBLE-240. Where the tool is actually defined — chump-mcp.json for server descriptors, the .rs file for macro-registered tools.

primitives.description: Flattened canonical list (AC #1). Every CLI/MCP-tool/skill/crate/script entry is also represented here with the canonical schema. Consumers that want a single iteration target read this; consumers that want kind-specific lists read cli_commands/event_kinds/crate_apis/mcp_tools.

when_to_use.description: One-line trigger hint, curated via docs/CAPABILITIES_OVERLAY.yaml.

version.description: semver or git-sha when the primitive's contract last changed.
